title: Imitation jewellery

review.classification: Confirmed CPC 38997 covers imitation jewellery. The named base-metal complete plated adornment is distinct from precious-metal and mechanically clad articles. Supplementary customs definitions support the physical distinction without establishing a CPC crosswalk.
review.route: The primary product page supports the brass complete heart necklace, its O-chain and gold-plated finish. The manufacturer's quality evidence supports finishing and separate plating responsibility. Material of each component, coating supplier inventory and actual gate tests remain site evidence.
review.measurement: Unique first release sets calibrated net mass Q. Raw physical and environmental burden vectors retain their actual gate and original cohort and use a single A/D normalization.
review.allocation: Assign dedicated processes and subdivide before measuring determining causality. Residual actual market allocation is limited to inseparable common-gate coproducts. Physical scrap quantities keep their original denominator.
review.bilingual: Scope, constituent procurement, outsourcing, release denominator, service transfer and allocation align across both renderings. The completed reference body's English historical native-family claim was corrected to match the Chinese method and the explicit unresolved reference state.
review.evidence_limits: Reference product and 62 other concrete exchanges remain unresolved. Mass/kg support was independently checked in the public historical ILCD snapshot. Nonblocking amount-range findings retain actual collection requirements.
